title: Generated recipe eval dispatch needs a declared consumer ABI
body: The d10 kernel's generated SdfRecipeEvalDispatch.g.inc unconditionally emits MaterialId sidecar storage and per-case locals, while VIXEN's legacy distance-only evalRecipe had no declared material buffers and -Werror made unused generated locals fail the consumer build. The VIXEN lane had to add local materialStack/materialPresent state, request --carry-output MaterialId, and bracket the generated include with compiler-diagnostic guards. Suggested consolidation: declare the evaluator ABI/legacy projection in the generated consumer contract and emit only the requested sidecar fields or a portable generated maybe-unused boundary.
